# Pasi

> Pasi is a mobile investment platform that lets retail users in Venezuela and Latin America buy tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs using stablecoins (USDC, USDT), with on-chain settlement on Solana via Jupiter aggregator. The product is in waitlist phase as of May 2026.

## About

- [Homepage](https://pasi.capital/): Main marketing site (Spanish).
- [How Pasi works](https://pasi.capital/como-funciona): Step-by-step explanation of how to invest in U.S. stocks from Venezuela using USDT or USDC.
- [Security and custody](https://pasi.capital/seguridad): Self-custody architecture, segregated funds, on-chain transparency, and compliance posture.
- [Help / FAQ](https://pasi.capital/ayuda): Common questions about Pasi, xStocks, stablecoin deposits, and Solana settlement.
- [About / Team](https://pasi.capital/nosotros): Built by Venezuelans who lived through the same financial exclusion they're solving.
- [Waitlist](https://pasi.capital/waitlist): Early access signup.

## Concepts

Pasi gives retail users access to xStocks (tokenized U.S. equities issued by Backed Finance, a Swiss-regulated entity) and other tokenized assets, settled on Solana via the Jupiter aggregator. Users fund accounts with USDC or USDT and gain on-chain price exposure to companies like Apple, Tesla, NVIDIA, and ETFs like SPY — without needing a U.S. bank account or a traditional broker.

Target audience: Spanish-speaking retail investors in Venezuela and Latin America who already use stablecoins for daily commerce and want exposure to U.S. equity markets.
